serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Mrs. Fisher: I hope you ate all these mackerels you caught. They are probably the healthiest and tastiest fish in all the oceans.
You: Really?
Mrs. Fisher: They prefer clean waters so they are mostly toxin free. You would think they would be quite rare here because of it, but somehow they are not. Oceans are full of them.
Mrs. Fisher: Just be sure to eat them quickly, they tend to spoil quite fast.
Mrs. Fisher: Smoked mackerel is quite a popular way to prepare them since it extends their shelf life. I highly recommend getting your hands on one, but it might be difficult in this economy.
You: If I ever see it at a shop, I will give it a try.
